text:
incident-bot: ALERT created  severity=sev2 region=us-west-1 symptom=elevated 5xx + auth failures impacting Hosted API and Dedicated pools

sara-ops: paging oncall  seeing a jump in 502/504 and a cluster of token fetch timeouts to keyring-auth-usw1. High tail latency on dataplane requests. @mike-sre @raj-eng please confirm

mike-sre: i'm oncall. first check: spikes align with auth latencies to keyring-auth-usw1 starting ~23:42 UTC. running blast-radius queries now.

anya-pm: support reports multiple customers with slow completions and some aborted requests. tagging product and CS. @emily-support are there any VIP escalations yet?

emily-support: two high-touch customers opened P1 tickets, one requesting immediate phone update. CS triage in progress.

raj-eng: pulling observability. traceburst (obs vendor) shows ingestion delays in us-west-1; tracing of control-plane calls shows auth call p95 went from ~350ms -> ~2.6s. trying raw access logs to avoid delay.

observability-bot: alert  traceburst ingestion lag 00:01:35 in us-west-1. Control-plane logs show increased timeouts to keyring-auth-usw1 (connect/timeouts).

mike-sre: mitigation idea set A (fast): 1) flip control-plane to local token cache (fail-open) 2) enable short-circuit static token for dedicated pool control-plane 3) gradually shift new sessions away from us-west-1 to us-east-2/eu-west-1 4) notify customers. I'll prioritize 1 and 2 immediately.

sara-ops: running the cache flip now. command: 
```
./controlplane/configure --set auth.fallback=local_cache --auth.ttl=45s
```
Applying now.

observability-bot: note  auth calls to keyring-auth-usw1 dropped ~78% after cache enabled, errors falling but still present for in-flight sessions. 5xx trending down from 7.1% -> 3.2%.

raj-eng: capacity check: us-east-2 can take ~20% additional sessions without spike; eu-west-1 roughly 40% spare. We should do incremental reroute 10% -> 30% in 5m windows.

mike-sre: ok start reroute 10% now; keep steps small to watch cold-start tail. Also enable circuit-breaker on auth calls for 10s to avoid cascading retries.

sara-ops: executing reroute step and circuit-breaker: 
```
./routing adjust --from us-west-1 --to eu-west-1 --pct 10 --window 300
./controlplane/toggles set circuit_breaker.auth_threshold=10s
```

anya-pm: drafting status message: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency in our us-west-1 region caused by a third-party auth provider (KeyRing). We're applying fallbacks and shifting traffic; some customers may see degraded performance. Updates every 15 minutes." @emily-support any edits?

emily-support: add "no customer data exposure suspected" and link to incident page placeholder. good to call out mitigation steps.

mike-sre: after the 10% shift: global 5xx down to ~1.9%. us-west-1 still ~2.9% due to sticky sessions. eu-west-1 cold-start latency +250ms but stable.

raj-eng: deploying a static SA fallback for Dedicated control-plane to reduce token dependency (read-only scope). Command: 
```
./dedicatedctl set-auth --backend static-sa --scope read-only --selector region=us-west-1
```
Applying now (audit log will show command).

sara-ops: applied. initial p95 auth latency for dedicated control-plane fell by ~600ms.

observability-bot: note  traceburst ingestion improving; backup internal aggregators confirm 5xx decreasing. Some traces remain delayed.

mike-sre: open ticket with KeyRing: INC-4021 created and escalated; told them this is production-impacting. Requesting ETA and whether fix will be unilateral or require region failover on their side.

incident-bot: Pager update  sent to @mike-sre (1/2).

anya-pm: enterprise owners notified; scheduling a quick sync with top-affected accounts in 20m. we'll offer credits if SLA breach extends beyond 90 minutes.

raj-eng: to help remaining 504s at edge, adding short retry wrapper for auth proxy calls (2 retries, 100ms backoff) to catch transient fails. Command: 
```
./edgectl feature enable --name auth-retry --retries 2 --backoff 100ms
```
Applied. Observed immediate reduction in 504s for legacy sessions.

sara-ops: proceeding with next reroute to 25% -> eu-west-1. Monitoring backlog on eu-west-1 for cold starts.

mike-sre: maintain cached-tokens for at least 90 minutes or until vendor confirms stable for 30 minutes. Prepare rollback plan doc in case of vendor partial restore causing token mismatch.

observability-bot: metrics snapshot: global 5xx 0.8%, us-west-1 1.4%. ingestion lag decreasing.

emily-support: support queue update: 10 affected high-QPS customers identified; outreach in progress. CS asking for a short bulletin for impacted customers explaining mitigation and next update ETA.

anya-pm: I'll lead the customer calls. started the first with one enterprise; they accepted temporary routing and want follow-up postmortem.

mike-sre: plan for next actions: 1) continue monitoring 2) keep reroute until us-west-1 <0.3% for 30m 3) coordinate with KeyRing for final restore 4) prepare incident summary for handoff. I'll remain hands-on for next 45m then hand to night oncall @leo-sre.

sara-ops: creating handoff checklist now and logging exact commands run for audit. Summary items: cause=KeyRing regional cache/inconsistency, mitigations=cached token fail-open (45s TTL), static-SA fallback for Dedicated, incremental routing shift to eu-west-1, auth proxy retries, circuit-breaker, customer comms.

incident-bot: KeyRing response: "Partial regional cache inconsistency identified; mitigation in progress; partial restoration observed in monitoring; no ETA yet." (INC-4021)

raj-eng: small follow-up: some sessions with long-lived sockets still hit expired tokens and cause backend 502s. adding short TTL refresh thread for long-lived sessions to proactively refresh tokens from cache.

sara-ops: refresh thread started; logs show token refreshes executed for long-lived sessions. 502s for those flows dropping.

observability-bot: final snapshot pre-handoff: global 5xx 0.25%, us-west-1 0.45%, traceburst ingestion near normal.

mike-sre: handing over to @leo-sre at 2319011400. full notes in incident doc. thanks team. :thumbsup:

leo-sre: ack taking over. monitoring and will post updates every 15m. please DM any new vendor messages.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED  last_update=2319011400 status=monitoring assignee=leo-sre
